propositions: Changes branched before the git-version-floor gate merged fail CI with 'missing <floorfile>' despite having no git-version edits, because the gate reads from the checked-out patchset tree while the workflow definition comes from main

The gate step hard-exits on absent .github/git-version-floor.txt without checking whether the file belongs to the patchset tree, violating the documented 'Definition-vs-tree skew guard' pattern already used by adjacent steps
The diagnostic 'missing <floorfile>' misleads authors to search for a file they never touched instead of naming the real remedy: rebase or wait for post-merge enforcement
An under-floor git should still fail with the full diagnostic (required version, installed version, upgrade path), and tests/conftest.py should remain unchanged
